There's plenty to share as each bundle comes with 24 individually wrapped stacking crayons. The fine tip works well for both defined lines and full color.

 How do the Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle) work? 

Color with the top crayon, then pull it off to reveal the tip of the next color and stack the rest back on top. You can also pull them apart to share with friends.

 What's included with the Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle)? 

The Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle) come with:

- 24 individually wrapped stacking crayons
- 12 fine-tipped heart crayons in 12 colors in each stacking crayon

 How many colors come with the Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle)? 

The Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle) come in 12 colors.

 Are the Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle) good for travel? 

Yes. The Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle) are compact and easy to take along for creativity on the go.

 What age are the Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle) for? 

The Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons (Classroom Bundle) are recommended for ages 3 and up.
